title: Harmony is not just for the Olds I promise!  Its actually really good...
transcript: I got to see Harmony first preview and I've been saying for months now that this was my most anticipated show of the fall! So did it live up to the hype? And the short answer is yes! I really love this show, and while I don't think it's perfect, and there's definitely a couple things that I hope they tighten up over previews, I think the show's in a really good shape! I got to see the show Off-Broadway, and went in knowing very little about it other than the fact that it was a musical by Barry Manilow, and honestly that really didn't excite me 😅 because I didn't really know Barry Manilow's music, it wasn't really a draw for me. I assumed it was for old people… And while yes, there is definitely an older audience for the show, I also think it will appeal to younger audiences, myself included, cause I think it's a really well told story! It is kind of similar to Cabaret, which is one of my all time favourite musicals, In that it focuses on Germany in the rise of Nazi power, and the lead up to the Holocaust. And similar to Cabaret, this focuses on performing artists, in this case the Comedian Harmonists, who are a real-life group of performers who were basically erased from history during the Holocaust because the Germans wiped out all of their records and movies from the face of existence. And so it's great that we now have this show to tell their story. And the six gentlemen that they have playing the Harmonist themselves are so! good! Not only are they individually talented, but their chemistry as a group is second to none, and a lot of my favourite numbers in the show are the numbers where the six of them are performing together in clubs and venues across the world. They’re these really fun throwback vaudvillian numbers that bring  in elements of acapella and slapstick in a really fun and creative ways. Act 2 is definitely a lot stronger than Act  1, and when I tell you I sobbed at the end 😭 Oh my god I don't even tend to cry at shows, but this show really gets to me. I obviously won't spoil anything, but you know as a show about the Holocaust it's probably not gonna have the happiest ending… And I did think that the ending to the show was really beautifully done. And so if you were on the fence about Harmony, or you thought maybe you weren't the target demo for it, I definitely recommend giving it a chance! I think it's a really really solid show, and I think it's gonna surprise a lot of people! For me, it is my favourite musical of the season so far, and I definitely think it will be in contention for that best musical race!
reasoning: Creator attended first preview, expresses strong enthusiasm, calls it their favorite musical of the season, and explicitly recommends it despite minor caveats about Act 1 needing tightening.
